value.rationale: Exact minimal conditioning of a minimal-outcome, one-defect Gabor matrix tomography design is a natural quantitative invariant. It gives the two unique optimal phase-amplitude choices in every even order >=6 and resolves a genuine zero-divisor parity obstruction for the natural positive impulse, while quantifying the sharp all-even \(N^{3/2}\) stability cost. This is not a generic arbitrary-slice computation or a renaming of the existing rank-only classification.
